messages.subject: recombination map comparison problem
parts:
Hello,
I am new to R and am doing a QTL mapping with mouse B6xDBA F2 data.  All seems fine except for one thing.  When I compare the input recombination map to the calculated recombination map, I see a strange map with left side at points and right sides of chromosomes expanded.  The axis lists cM of zero to 50000!  But when I look at the other maps the sizes look correct.  It is only the comparison that gives me a funny output.  Any ideas?  I attached the map.  I used the JAX website to convert my SNP to cM, and some of the cM values came out negative.   I changed these to small positive values, but it did not change the comparison map.  

I input some sample data and the comparison map was fine.

Any advice is most welcome, thanks much!  Lynn

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] recombination map comparison problem
parts:
It seems like there are some big problems with the genotypes: that markers aren't showing linkage to each other. Have you used the B6 and DBA genotypes to convert F2 genotypes to BB (B6 homozygote), BD (heterozygote), DD (DBA homozygote)?

karl
